title: Hintersteiner See Scheffau
highlights: Crystal-clear mountain lake situated in the heart of the Wilder Kaiser nature reserve
Subterranean mountain springs delivering water of certified drinking-water purity
Charming lido on the eastern bank featuring a sunbathing lawn and lakeside cafe
One of Tyrol's most rewarding shoreline hiking paths framing the Kaiser mountain range
kurzbeschreibung: The Hintersteiner See above Scheffau is a crystal-clear mountain lake situated in the nature reserve of the Wilder Kaiser.
beschreibung:
Crystal-Clear Jewel in the Kaisergebirge

Covering 56 hectares, the Hintersteiner See is situated at 882 metres above sea level above Scheffau in the heart of the protected Kaisergebirge nature reserve. Fed by underground mountain springs, the lake enchants visitors with its extraordinary visibility depth of up to ten metres.

Circular Hike and Swimming Fun

On the eastern shore, a charming little lido offers refreshing dips in the pure mountain water. A wonderful hiking trail runs along the steep southern bank through shady mountain forest, opening up fascinating views of the shimmering turquoise waters in which the rock faces of the Wilder Kaiser are mirrored.
